evals.prompt: I added retry logic with exponential backoff to the Stripe webhook handler. Write me a commit message.
evals.description: Simple feature addition; should produce a clean conventional commit.
expected_output_criteria: First line follows pattern: type(scope): short subject in imperative voice
Type is `feat` and scope reasonably identifies the webhook handler
Subject line is <= 72 characters and does not end with a period
Body (if present) explains why the retry was added, not just what
No reference to 'AI', 'Claude', or boilerplate co-author tags unless asked

evals.prompt: Squash these 4 commits into one for the auth refactor PR: 'wip', 'fix tests', 'rename helper', 'finally working'. The PR migrates session storage from Redis to a Postgres-backed table and removes the old token TTL.
evals.description: PR cleanup / squash commit; should produce a single coherent message.
expected_output_criteria: Produces one commit message, not four
Type is `refactor` or `feat` consistent with the scope of the change
Subject describes the actual change (session storage migration), not the WIP labels
Body summarises the migration, mentions the removed TTL, and groups the test/rename details as a single bullet list or paragraph
Discards the noisy 'wip' / 'finally working' language entirely

evals.prompt: I removed the deprecated v1 REST endpoints. Anyone still on v1 will get 404s after this lands. Write the commit message.
evals.description: Breaking change; must include BREAKING CHANGE footer correctly.
expected_output_criteria: Subject line includes `!` after the type/scope (e.g., `feat(api)!:` or `refactor(api)!:`) OR uses BREAKING CHANGE footer per spec
Body explicitly contains a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer with an explanation
Footer names the affected callers (v1 REST clients) and the symptom (404)
Subject is still under 72 characters and in imperative voice
Does not invent migration steps that were not in the prompt; states 'no migration path provided' if applicable
